description: Human-macaque identity of the LRIT2 micro-exon against its own local intronic neutral background
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
E="https://rest.ensembl.org"; H={"Content-Type":"application/json"}
def ens(p):
    r=requests.get(E+p,headers=H,timeout=240); r.raise_for_status(); return r.json()

# Human-macaque LASTZ alignment across a 3 kb window spanning the micro-exon,
# to ask whether the exon is more conserved than its own local neutral background.
START,END=84221600,84224600     # spans intron, micro-exon, and part of exon 3
al=ens(f"/alignment/region/human/10:{START}-{END}?species_set=homo_sapiens;species_set=macaca_mulatta;method=LASTZ_NET;content-type=application/json")
print("alignment blocks:",len(al))
best=max(al,key=lambda b: len(b["alignments"][0]["seq"]))
seqs={a["species"]:a["seq"].upper() for a in best["alignments"]}
hstart=[a for a in best["alignments"] if a["species"]=="homo_sapiens"][0]["start"]
h=seqs["homo_sapiens"]; m=seqs["macaca_mulatta"]
print("block: human %d-%d, aligned columns %d"%(hstart,[a for a in best["alignments"] if a["species"]=="homo_sapiens"][0]["end"],len(h)))

# map alignment columns -> human genomic coordinate
col2pos=[]; pos=hstart
for c in h:
    col2pos.append(pos if c!="-" else None)
    if c!="-": pos+=1
col2pos=np.array([p if p is not None else -1 for p in col2pos])

def window_identity(gs,ge):
    cols=[i for i,p in enumerate(col2pos) if gs<=p<=ge]
    if len(cols)<10: return None,0
    hh="".join(h[i] for i in cols); mm="".join(m[i] for i in cols)
    n=sum(1 for a,b in zip(hh,mm) if a!="-" and b!="-")
    ident=sum(1 for a,b in zip(hh,mm) if a==b and a!="-")
    return (ident/n if n else None), n

# sliding 30-bp windows across the whole aligned region = local neutral background
ids=[]; centers=[]
p=hstart
while p+30<=col2pos.max():
    v,n=window_identity(p,p+29)
    if v is not None and n>=25: ids.append(v); centers.append(p+15)
    p+=10
ids=np.array(ids); centers=np.array(centers)
me,_=window_identity(84222828,84222857)
ex3,_=window_identity(84222620,84222649)      # constitutive exon 3 window, positive control
print("\nhuman-macaque identity, 30 bp windows across chr10:%d-%d (n=%d windows)"%(START,END,len(ids)))
print("  background mean %.3f, median %.3f, sd %.3f"%(ids.mean(),np.median(ids),ids.std()))
print("  micro-exon (84,222,828-84,222,857): %.3f  -> percentile %.0f%%"%(me,100*(ids<me).mean()))
print("  constitutive exon 3 window (84,222,620-84,222,649): %.3f -> percentile %.0f%%"%(ex3,100*(ids<ex3).mean()))
print("  fraction of neutral background windows at 100%% identity: %.2f"%(ids==1.0).mean())
from scipy import stats
print("  binomial p for 30/30 matches given local background rate %.3f: p=%.3f"%(ids.mean(), stats.binom.sf(29,30,ids.mean())+stats.binom.pmf(30,30,ids.mean())))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,4))
ax.plot(centers,ids,lw=1,color="#555555",label="30 bp sliding window")
ax.axhline(ids.mean(),ls="--",color="grey",lw=.8,label="local background mean %.2f"%ids.mean())
ax.axvspan(84222828,84222857,color="crimson",alpha=.35,label="isoform 2 micro-exon")
ax.axvspan(84222571,84222680,color="steelblue",alpha=.3,label="constitutive exon 3")
ax.set_xlabel("chr10 position (GRCh38)"); ax.set_ylabel("human-macaque identity")
ax.set_title("LRIT2 micro-exon sits at the local neutral background: 100% human-macaque identity is\ncommon in this intron, so primate identity does not indicate constraint",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower left"); ax.set_ylim(0.4,1.05)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
